summary: Quantumoney.app – Web app and PWA (QuantumoneyAR.app) recovery and synchronization build. Restoring full functionality including animated HOME, complete Profile with wallet, Banco Central, DAO, Chat, and Map modules. Both apps must share the same canisters (Carteira A) with real-time data sync. No Caffeine references anywhere.
architectural_notes: Both Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app must share the same Internet Computer canisters (Carteira A) — no duplication
All data (coins, XP, monsters, history, vesting) must sync in real-time between site and PWA
No Caffeine references in any page, footer, meta tags, or code comments
known_issues: Previous builds introduced Caffeine references and broke wallet/profile visibility — must be fully removed
Version reversions (262–265) caused instability; current recovery build targets restoring stable state from v264 baseline
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Golden ICP coin illustration with metallic sheen on transparent background (icp-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png)
- Golden QMY coin illustration with metallic sheen on transparent background (qmy-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Remove ALL references to 'Caffeine' from the entire application: footer, meta tags in index.html (Open Graph, Twitter cards, description), comments in source files, and any visible UI text. No Caffeine branding must appear anywhere.

Replace the footer component (Footer.tsx) so it shows ONLY the text 'By HTgamers' and four social share buttons: WhatsApp, X (Twitter), Telegram, and Instagram. Remove all other navigation links, legal links, and branding from the footer.

Apply a global visual style across all pages: all text must use yellow color (e.g., #FFD700 or equivalent gold-yellow), all card/panel/modal windows must be transparent with thin yellow borders (1–2px), and layouts must be compact without clipping page headers or top navigation.

Rebuild the HomePage (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx) with: (1) a full-screen animated universe background with stars, planets, comets, and meteorites using the existing SpaceBackground component or equivalent CSS animation; (2) golden ICP and QMY coins that appear at the center every 5 seconds, grow smoothly over 3 seconds with a scale-up animation giving the impression they are emerging from the screen, then fade out; (3) a short professional welcome message: 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World'; (4) a prominent CTA button that links directly to https://quantumoneyar.app.

Rebuild the Profile page (frontend/src/pages/Perfil.tsx) to include: (1) display of the authenticated user's username, editable and synced with the backend; (2) a profile photo section using ProfilePhotoUpload component with upload and preview capability, persisted to the backend player profile; (3) an integrated wallet panel showing live ICP and QMY balances fetched from the same Carteira A canisters; (4) Send and Receive panels for transferring ICP and QMY tokens between principals; (5) transaction history for both ICP and QMY; (6) XP and level display using ARPlayerStats. All data must read from and write to the shared backend canister so changes are immediately visible when the same principal logs into QuantumoneyAR.app.

Restore the DAO module: ensure DAOPage.tsx lists active proposals, DAOCreateProposalPage.tsx allows authenticated registered users to submit proposals, and DAOProposalDetailPage.tsx shows vote counts with yes/no/abstain voting. Wire all three pages through App.tsx routes. The DAO.tsx stub file must either be removed or re-export DAOPage.

Restore the public Chat page (PublicChatPage.tsx): users can enter a name and send messages, messages auto-scroll to latest, and the UI uses the global yellow text / transparent yellow-border style. Ensure the route is registered in App.tsx.

Restore the Map page (MapPage.tsx) using Leaflet OpenStreetMap: display coin drop markers and monster spawn markers on the interactive map. Use static fallback data from mapDatasets.ts when the backend returns empty results. Ensure the Leaflet CSS is loaded (already in index.html via CDN) and the map renders correctly at full height without layout clipping.

Ensure all page routes in App.tsx are correctly registered and lazy-loaded for: Home, Profile (Perfil), Banco Central, DAO (all three sub-pages), Chat, Map, Swap, Docs, Gold Paper, Tokenomics, Roadmap, Legal, About, Contact, Technical, Presale, and pre-proposals. Remove or fix any broken or empty route targets.

new_feature_requests.summary: Footer: only 'By HTgamers', no Caffeine, share buttons: WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Instagram
Global style: all text yellow, transparent windows with thin yellow borders, compact layout without cutting headers

HOME: animated universe background (stars, planets, comets, meteorites), golden ICP/QMY coins appearing every 5s growing from center, welcome message 'Bem-vindo ao mundo Quantumoney', button linking to QuantumoneyAR.app
Profile page: username + photo (upload/edit), integrated wallet showing ICP & QMY with send/receive, transaction history and XP, real-time sync with QuantumoneyAR.app
Banco Central: full professional page with vesting details, coin burn, charts, tables, downloadable data, full QMY transparency
DAO, Chat, and Map (Leaflet OpenStreetMap) fully functional with geographic distribution of coins and monsters synced with QuantumoneyAR.app
Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app must use the same canisters (Carteira A) — no duplicate canisters, full real-time sync of coins, XP, monsters, history, vesting

Ensure the backend actor (backend/main.mo) stores and exposes profile photo data (as a Blob or base64 Text) and username as part of the player profile stable record. Add or update the updateProfile, getProfile, and getMyProfile functions to include photoUrl and nickname fields. This ensures both Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app read from the same canister data.

Restore and complete the Banco Central page (frontend/src/pages/BancoCentral.tsx) as a full professional dashboard including: tokenomics stat cards (total, circulating, locked, vesting, burned supply), a vesting schedule table and chart, a burn history table, supply charts (bar/line), an explanatory accordion section, and download buttons for CSV/text reports. All data must be sourced from centralBankSimData.ts and rendered using the existing central-bank sub-components.

Verify and enforce that all frontend canister references (in useARGameData.ts, useICPLedger.ts, useQMYLedger.ts, and TechnicalValidationPanel.tsx / CanisterArchitecturePanel.tsx) use the Carteira A canister IDs as listed on TechnicalPage.tsx. Remove or replace any divergent canister IDs introduced in previous builds.
